name: Seattle FMC and Big Cubes 2026

venue.name: University of Washington, Spratlen Hall 313
venue.address: 4320 Little Canoe Channel NE, Seattle, WA 98195
venue.details: Enter through the South corner. Room 313 is on the ground floor. Spratlen Hall was recently renamed and may show up as Madrona Hall (the old name) on maps.

information: This competition is primarily a "PBQ", or "Please Be Quiet" competition. We will be holding blindfolded events and Fewest Moves, not traditional events like 3x3. Additionally, we will be hosting two rounds each of the big cubes 6x6 and 7x7. As such, this competition is not recommended for first-time competitors, although you are still welcome to sign up. You can find other Washington competitions with more standard event lists [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=US&search=Washington).
